name: duopore-public-room-area-reconciliation
description: Add up rectangular room areas and compare them with the floor area you entered.

interface.longDescription: Add up rectangular room areas and compare them with the floor area you entered. Share each room's length and width in metres, plus the stated total area. See room estimates, their sum and any difference from that total. Use it to check your sums. It is not a survey or a legal floor-area measurement.
defaultPrompt: Add up these rectangular room areas in square metres.
Compare the room area total with the floor area I entered.

positive.prompt: Use Room Area Reconciliation with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"rooms":[{"id":"R1","label":"Living","lengthMetres":4,"widthMetres":3},{"id":"R2","label":"Bedroom","lengthMetres":3,"widthMetres":3}],"declaredArea":22,"tolerance":0.5}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"Estimated room sum 21 m²; difference -1 m².","rows":[{"id":"R1","label":"Living","estimatedArea":12,"declaredTotal":22,"estimatedTotal":21,"difference":-1,"withinTolerance":false},{"id":"R2","label":"Bedroom","estimatedArea":9,"declaredTotal":22,"estimatedTotal":21,"difference":-1,"withinTolerance":false}],"warnings":["Rectangular estimates omit walls, irregular shapes and unlisted areas. This is not a legal floor-area measurement.","Areas and differences use four decimal places; tolerance is applied to the displayed difference."]}
